summary: An Italianate SF painted lady on a 16x50 lot. A three-storey angled bay stands on a rusticated garage plinth, beside a stone stoop rising to a recessed two-column porch. A bracketed cornice and a false-front parapet with a centre pediment hide the flat roof, and the blank party walls make the painted front read as a mask. The lot climbs to a back garden 2 blocks higher, so the garage storey is exposed at the front and buried at the back under a timber deck. Italianate SF painted lady: a sage-teal false-front with a plum-and-cream bracketed cornice, a 3-storey angled bay over a rusticated garage plinth, and a stoop up to a columned recessed porch, all between blank brick party walls. A deep lot climbs to a spruce deck, lawn and a tree, with raised beds at the back. elements.md plus palette, vocabulary, 18 room boxes and 6 parts are appended to plan.md.
